fact: The Niger government has mentioned plans to enhance its national data center capacity and cybersecurity architecture and build domestic expertise to reduce external dependence, as part of a digital sovereignty push alongside the new AES biometric ID.
source_slug: 2026-03-30 Focus on Sahel digital sovereignty gets clearer with Niger's new biometric ID card

fact: The National Agency for the Information Society (ANSI) says Niger's national data centre, under construction as its director-general inspected the site on 29 October 2026, is meant to host and secure the public administration's data and applications as strategic infrastructure for digital sovereignty.

West Africa Weekly reports that Niger installed a national committee to oversee the deployment and security of critical digital infrastructure as part of a strategy for digital sovereignty, following a June 2025 ministerial decree creating a body to design a sector classification of critical infrastructure.
